newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq boosted by computer, semiconductor stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq boosted by computer, semiconductor stocks.

text.p: The Nasdaq market continued to rally Thursday thanks to a boost from semiconductor and computer stocks, gaining ground in contrast to a moderate decline on the Big Board.
The Nasdaq composite index gained 5.76 points, or 0.36 percent, to close unofficially at 1593.81. Advancing issues beat declines 11 to 10 on total volume of 686 million shares.

"Nasdaq was fueled by extraordinary strength in the semiconductor area, particularly from the big caps like Dell, Intel and Microsoft," one trader said. He noted the market rose 30 points, almost two percent, in the past three sessions.
Dell Computer Corp jumped 3-1/4 to 85-1/2. Morgan Stanley Dean Whitter raised its 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates earlier in the day on the computer maker.
Intel Corp, the most actively traded issue, rose 2-7/16 to 91-13/16, while Alliance Semiconductor Corp advanced 2-7/16 to 14-9/16.
But shares of WorldCom Inc eased 15/16 to 34-15/16 after its second quarter earnings topped the anaysts' consensus estimate, but disappointed investors expecting even better results, traders said.
